hook: Train Bix, a little brain buddy, on real puzzles: a not-yet you come back from with a strategy earns a gold comeback stripe, and the goals you set open new rooms.
outcome: Set a personal goal, plan a strategy for when you get stuck, and keep going after mistakes by trying a new approach
sources: CASEL, What Is the CASEL Framework? Self-Management: setting personal goals, self-motivation, planning: https://casel.org/fundamentals-of-sel/what-is-the-casel-framework/
Dweck, C. S. (2006). Mindset: The New Psychology of Success. Random House ('not yet' framing, mistakes as information)

Dweck, C. S. (2015). Carol Dweck Revisits the 'Growth Mindset'. Education Week (new strategies and help from others, not effort alone): https://www.edweek.org/leadership/opinion-carol-dweck-revisits-the-growth-mindset/2015/09
Sisk, V. F., et al. (2018). Psychological Science 29(4), 549-571, and Yeager, D. S., et al. (2019). Nature 573, 364-369 (small average effects, so the tool only says practice helps)
